rationale: The only implementation delta is the argument passed to FreeStmt: the vulnerable version passes the address of the local append parameter, while the fixed version passes the append object itself. The Logic section states only that memory associated with the second expression is freed, which is the intended high-level operation and is abstract enough not to specify either pointer-passing mechanism. All other described list-size, map-update, concatenation, and return behavior is common to both versions.
